title: PremiumPaymentEvent
description: Canonical premium payment event (v1), published on the Service Bus topic premium-payment-events. Provider-independent. Never contains payer personal data (names, national ids, emails) or payment tokens. Versioning: the major version is in $id (v1) and in the topic contract; schemaVersion carries major.minor. Minor versions only add optional fields, so consumers must ignore unknown fields. A breaking change is a new major version with its own schema and a parallel publication period.

schemaVersion.description: major.minor of this contract. Any 1.x is valid against this schema.

eventId.description: Deterministic business key of the event (idempotency key): <paymentKey>:<status>, or <paymentKey>:REFUNDED:<amountRefunded> for refunds. Identical for every retry of the same business event.

paymentKey.description: <PROVIDER>-<providerTransactionId>. Identity of the payment; written to Premium_Payment__c.Payment_Key__c.

providerTransactionId.description: Charge, transaction or payment id at the provider.

providerEventId.description: Provider's id of the notification that produced this event (Quetzal id, Andina notificacion_id, Austral eventId). For traceability only; not an idempotency key.

policyNumber.description: Normalized policy number, upper case. Its country must match country.

status.description: Canonical lifecycle status. Maps 1:1 to Premium_Payment__c.Status__c (Pending, Captured, Failed, Refunded).

amount.description: Payment amount in the major unit of the currency, as a decimal string (no floating point). Two decimals for MXN and COP; no decimals for CLP.

amountRefunded.description: Cumulative amount refunded so far, major unit. Required when status is REFUNDED; absent otherwise.

currency.description: ISO 4217, upper case. Must match country.

statusChangedAt.description: Time of the state change at the provider, UTC.

receivedAt.description: Time Meridian received the notification, UTC. Used to measure freshness (NFR2).

correlationId.description: Created by payment-intake and carried end to end in logs, traces and message properties (NFR7).

allOf.description: Refunds carry amountRefunded; other statuses do not.
Mexico: Quetzal, MXN with two decimals, POL-MX policies.
Colombia: Andina, COP with two decimals, POL-CO policies.
Chile: Austral, CLP without decimals, POL-CL policies.
